orders.text:
WPSS No. 954 of 2019 
Hon’ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
 
Mr. Anil Kumar and Mr. B.S. Adhikari, 
Advocates for the petitioner. 
Mr. Susheel Vasistha, Brief Holder for 
the State of Uttarakhand. 
Mr. Akshya Latwal, Advocate, holding 
brief of Mr. Nathi Singh Pundir, Advocate for 
the respondent no. 4. 
Heard learned counsel for the parties. 
As prayed four weeks’ time is granted 
to learned counsel for the petitioner to file 
counter affidavits. 
List this matter alongwith WPSS No. 
782 of 2019. 
Till the next date of listing, no recovery 
shall be made from the petitioner. 
Stay application (CLMA NO. 5578 of 
2019) stands disposed of. 
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.) 
NEHA 29.04.2019
